title: Semgrep SAST with vendored AzGuard rules
summary: Adds `.semgrep/rules/<name>.yml` (one file per rule) with the eight rules of knowledge/security-gates#semgrep-rules, rule tests under `.semgrep/tests/`, semgrep (docker digest) to the tool lock, and the blocking `semgrep` job to `security.yml`; triages every finding on the current tree.
why: P1 A07: PHPStan max proves types, not taint; the audit lists AzGuard-specific dangerous patterns (raw SQL interpolation, unserialize, dynamic code/class, sensitive logging, grant-table access from outer layers, catch-to-allow, testing fakes in runtime). Risks: over-broad patterns flood findings and invite blanket suppression — every suppression is inline, rule-scoped and reasoned; a fix in `packages/**` is allowed only for a real defect (conventions item 4).

include: `.github/security-tools.lock`: `semgrep` kind `docker` (`semgrep/semgrep@sha256:<digest>` of the latest release tag)
`security.yml` job `semgrep` (`Semgrep (AzGuard rules)`) added to the aggregate needs
Inline `// nosemgrep: azguard.<rule> -- <reason>` only where a finding is a proven false positive; list them in `plans/2026.10.17-№1-AZGUARD-FINAL-HARDENING/artifacts/evidence/P2.2/triage.md`
Exclude `.semgrep/tests` from Pint/PHPStan/Rector if their configs would pick it up (`pint.json`, `phpstan.neon`, `rector.php`)

reads.why: Branch, commits, owner WIP, frozen-contract stop rule, owner gates, evidence
Existing boundary rules not to duplicate blindly
Grammar wrappers the SQL rule must exempt

rules: Each rule has at least one `ruleid` and one `ok` line in its test file.
Docker runs mount the repo read-only: `-v "$PWD:/src:ro" -w /src`.
guidance: Resolve the digest: `docker pull semgrep/semgrep:<version> && docker inspect --format '{{index .RepoDigests 0}}' semgrep/semgrep:<version>`. Use `--metrics=off` always.

validation.cmd: composer lint:check && composer analyse && composer refactor:check

validation.procedure: Push (gate CI-PUSH); ci-runs check including Security

result.notes: rules fixed by hand after conductor stop (dynamic-class rewritten pattern-based, metavariable regex, docker entrypoint); V5 live waits CI-PUSH
